name: Aino Nieminen
bio:
Aino's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a shared workshop space with a local rally team after completing her engineering degree. Initially drawn to the intricacies of materials science, she quickly became fascinated by the challenges of composite design in racing. She honed her skills over several years, developing a keen eye for identifying weaknesses and implementing innovative solutions to improve durability and performance.

At RFK Racing, Aino brings a meticulous and ambitious approach to composite construction. She's known for her ability to visualize the bigger picture, understanding how even the smallest composite component contributes to the overall vehicle dynamics. While detail-oriented, she also encourages experimentation and pushes the boundaries of what's possible, believing that innovation is crucial for staying ahead in the competitive world of motorsport. Her colleagues respect her deep understanding of materials and her dedication to producing high-quality, reliable components.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often tucked behind her ears.
physical.description: Aino is a woman of average height with a sturdy build and a focused, intelligent expression.

quirks: Always has a thermos of strong black coffee on her workbench.
Meticulously cleans her tools after every use, regardless of how busy she is.
Often hums quietly to herself while working, usually Finnish folk tunes.
